summary.text: John Erickson is a Democratic candidate for California State Senate District 24, an open seat with no incumbent, in the November 3, 2026 general election against fellow Democrat Brian Goldsmith.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a community organizer, nonprofit executive and West Hollywood city councilmember.

paragraphs.text: John Erickson said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is chief of staff at Alliance for a Better Community and was formerly vice president of Planned Parenthood Los Angeles.
He said he was elected to the West Hollywood City Council in 2020.
According to the survey, his council work includes renters' rights, homelessness solutions, health care access and public safety, and he helped create WeHo Cares.
Erickson advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary in first place with 20.5% of the vote.
The survey response says his campaign centers on immigrants, women, LGBTQ+ people and working families, along with the cost of living, housing affordability and public safety.
